name: SDN HTTP Respond
description: Single-purpose flow node: assembles one $HTR HttpResponse envelope from a routing-decision JSON frame (foundation/http-route contract) plus optional body / etag / error frames. Behavior: an "error" input (JSON {"error":msg}) wins over everything -> 502 application/json {"error":msg}; decision route=not_found -> 404 application/json {"error":decision.error|"not found"}; an "etag" input equal to decision.ifNoneMatch -> 304 with an etag header and empty body; otherwise 200 with the body frame verbatim (empty body when the frame is absent), content-type from decision.format (flatbuffer -> application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream, json -> application/json), x-sdn-record-count when derivable (the count of size-prefixed frames when format=flatbuffer and the body framing parses cleanly), and an etag header whenever the etag input is present. All response headers are lower-cased and sorted per the $HTR ABI. Pure compute — no capabilities. Body-reference delivery (loop C.5c): a body input frame that is a {"$sdnbodyref":1,"token":..,"size":..,"frames":..,"fnv1a64":".."} JSON descriptor (instead of stream bytes) is forwarded as $HTR BODY_REF_TOKEN/BODY_REF_SIZE with no inline body; the host egress substitutes the buffer it registered under the token. x-sdn-record-count then comes from the descriptor's frames field. v0.2.1: error decisions may carry a machine-readable "code" string (gateway loop G.5 sandbox rejection codes) forwarded verbatim into the JSON error body.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Routing-decision UTF-8 JSON bytes from foundation/http-route (aligned-binary wire format): {"route","format","ifNoneMatch"?,"error"?,...}.

inputPorts.description: Routing decision controlling status, content-type, and conditional-request handling.

acceptedTypeSets.description: JSON response or body-reference control bytes.

wildcardJustification.detail: JSON response bodies and body-reference descriptors are flow-local material and carry no SDS record identity.

inputPorts.description: Optional opaque response body; absent means an empty 200 body.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Entity tag as raw UTF-8 string bytes. Compared verbatim against decision.ifNoneMatch for 304 handling and echoed as the etag response header.
Upstream error as UTF-8 JSON bytes {"error":"message"} (plain text tolerated). Presence forces a 502 response.
Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.

methods.description: Builds the $HTR response: 502 on upstream error, 404 on not_found, 304 on ETag match, else 200 with negotiated content-type, optional x-sdn-record-count, and optional etag header. G.4 adds the explicit error decision: route=error answers decision.status (clamped 400-599, default 503) application/json {"error":msg,"pnm":{...}?} — the optional pnm publication pointer object is forwarded verbatim from the decision so unavailability answers stay actionable (no silent proxying).
